verdict.rationale: CoreWeave documents installable generated clients for its Inference API in Go, Python, TypeScript, Java, Kotlin, Rust and Swift, so developers need not hand-write HTTP calls. The evidence covers only the Inference API: the CKS cluster API and other services show only Terraform, Console and raw API access, not SDKs. missing for 10: SDK coverage beyond the Inference API (CKS, storage, networking), detailed SDK reference/installation docs, a published OpenAPI spec (probe returned 404), independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Clients are available for the Connect, gRPC, and Protobuf ecosystems across languages including Go, Python, TypeScript, Java, Kotlin, Rust, and Swift.
you can install a generated client instead of writing HTTP calls by hand.
The CoreWeave Inference API provides programmatic control over inference gateways, model deployments, and capacity claims.
